theorems.name: Opposite-face even-value model
theorems.statement: The four triangular holonomies of a K4 overlap-sign cochain, assigned to their opposite vertices, form an even-parity F2-valued function on the four vertices; the kernel is exactly the vertex-coboundary space.

theorems.name: Holonomy-to-endpoint-residual isomorphism
theorems.statement: The chirality graph cohomology H1(K4;F2) and the mod-two endpoint residual module are explicitly isomorphic by e=h_BCD, p=h_BCD+h_ACD, q=h_BCD+h_ABD, with the displayed inverse formulas.

theorems.name: S4-equivariant representation bridge
theorems.statement: Under the canonical opposite-face bijection, the holonomy module and endpoint residual module are the same even-parity permutation module on four vertices; the bridge commutes with all 24 vertex permutations.
theorems.boundary: The current Lean file packages the coordinate inverses and S4-invariant line; a general Equiv.Perm naturality wrapper is not claimed.

theorems.name: Invariant holonomy class equals torsion line mod two
theorems.statement: The all-four-face holonomy-one class maps to affine coordinates (p,q,e)=(0,0,1), the constant-one state and mod-two shadow of the primitive endpoint-sum two-torsion class.

theorems.name: Six edge-state orbit
theorems.statement: The six remaining nonzero non-torsion states have two-vertex support and reconstruct the six K4 edges; adding the torsion state complements support and exchanges opposite edges.
